card.name: Inside fda.gov web addresses
card.fires_on: The 'da' piece of 'www.fda.gov' in FDA web links, mostly the companion diagnostics link. Also the '.i' in 'b.i.d.' dosing abbreviations.

modes.label: fda.gov link
modes.description: The 'da' after 'f' in an FDA web address, usually the companion diagnostics page.
modes.example: Information on FDA-approved tests for the detection of ALK rearrangements in NSCLC is available at http://www.f<<da>>.gov/CompanionDiagnostics .

modes.label: b.i.d. abbreviation
modes.description: The '.i' inside the dosing abbreviation b.i.d.
modes.example: Levodopa (mg) Suggested Dosage Regimen 300-400 200 mg b<<.i>>.d. 500-6
